# Mist.AI

> Mist.AI is a free personal AI assistant built by Kristian Cook. It is powered by three LLMs (Gemini, Command R, and Mistral) with real-time web grounding, meaning it has no fixed knowledge cutoff. It is not affiliated with Juniper Networks' "Mist AI" enterprise networking product.

## What Mist.AI is
- A personal AI assistant, similar in purpose to ChatGPT or Claude, aimed at everyday users rather than enterprise IT.
- Available on the web (mistai.org), as a Chrome/Firefox browser extension, and as a Windows desktop app (Mist.AI Desktop).
- Always free — no paid tier, no subscriptions.

## Key features
- Multi-model pipeline: Gemini, Command R, and Mistral
- Real-time web search grounding (no static knowledge cutoff)
- Image uploads and Gemini Vision understanding
- File uploads (PDF, DOCX, TXT, JSON)
- Session memory and chat threads
- Slash commands (/weather, /news, /joke, /riddle, etc.)
- Custom themes and PWA offline support
